summary: REQ-7 appears implemented by removing the Transformation section from the Home page composition. REQ-8 appears implemented by enhancing the shared Footer with company name, description, and quick links. The Footer also adds extra, unrequested elements (contact info and caffeine.ai attribution/UTM tracking).

hallucinated_features.description: Footer adds a new "Get In Touch" contact info block (location and phone number) beyond the requested company name/description/quick links.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-8 only requested (1) company name, (2) short description, and (3) quick links; contact info was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer adds a "Built with … using caffeine.ai" attribution link including UTM tracking based on hostname, plus a heart icon.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in REQ-8; introduces new external outbound link/tracking behavior not mentioned in requirements.
